name: Word Specificity Index
algorithm: Word Specificity Index — Statistical Pattern Analyzer
mechanism:
This method performs linguistic analysis for AI-generated text detection:

1. **Text Preprocessing**: The input text is tokenized and processed for analysis.

2. **Feature Extraction**: Measures word specificity level. Relevant linguistic features are computed from the text.

3. **Statistical Analysis**: Features are compared against baseline distributions from human-written vs AI-generated corpora.

4. **Pattern Detection**: Anomalous patterns characteristic of AI generation are identified.

5. **Score Computation**: A confidence score (0-100) is calculated based on detected patterns.
parameters:
Analysis type: statistical
Media: text
Input: Raw text string
Minimum text length: 100 characters
Output: Confidence score (0-100)
Processing: Client-side NLP analysis
accuracy: Moderate to High — 65-85% standalone accuracy. Performance increases significantly when combined with complementary text analysis methods. Results vary with text length, language, and content type.
source: Statistical NLP analysis methods for AI-generated text detection. Based on computational linguistics and information theory research.
useCase: Detection of AI-generated text through word specificity index analysis. This method examines specific linguistic patterns that differ between human-written and AI-generated text, providing complementary evidence in a multi-method analysis pipeline.
strengths:
• Fast client-side analysis with no server required
• Effective as part of a multi-method analysis pipeline
• Works across various text types and genres
• Based on established linguistic research
• Complements other statistical text analysis methods
limitations:
• Best used in combination with other text analysis methods
• Performance varies with text length (requires sufficient text)
• May be affected by text language and writing style
• Accuracy depends on the AI model used for generation
• Human writing can occasionally trigger false positives
